title: Income Tax Deductions under Section 80C, 80D, and Chapter VI-A
source: Income Tax Department, Government of India
content: Under the Old Tax Regime, Chapter VI-A provides deductions from gross total income: Section 80C allows deductions up to ₹1,50,000 per financial year for investments in EPF, PPF, ELSS mutual funds, home loan principal repayment, Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana, and life insurance premiums. Section 80D provides deductions up to ₹25,000 for health insurance premiums for self/family (₹50,000 for senior citizens) plus an additional ₹25,000/₹50,000 for parents. Section 80CCD(1B) provides an additional ₹50,000 deduction for NPS investments.
